title: Semantic Views: Certified Reuse of LLM Labels Across Semantic Queries
abstract: arXiv:2610.12768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Semantic query engines evaluate natural-language filters with a large language model, and every evaluation is a costly oracle call. Optimizers that reduce these calls face a dilemma: cascades that trust a cheap proxy miss their precision and recall targets on many queries, methods with finite-sample guarantees save little, and all of them discard the oracle's labels when the query ends. We present SemViews, a certified semantic filter that orders tuples by signals that cost no oracle calls (the labels that earlier queries left behind as semantic views, a local embedding, and a helper model's score), refines that order with labels it must pay for anyway, and certifies its answer with fresh stratified oracle samples. The answer meets user precision and recall targets with probability at least $1-\delta$ for every workload and every catalog, so a stale or misleading view can cost oracle calls but never accuracy. On four workloads replayed

translated_title: 语义视图：跨语义查询的LLM标签认证复用
translated_abstract: 语义查询引擎使用大语言模型来评估自然语言过滤器，而每次评估都是一次代价高昂的预言机调用。旨在减少这些调用的优化器面临两难困境：信任廉价代理的级联方法在许多查询上无法达到精确率和召回率目标，具有有限样本保证的方法节省有限，而且所有这些方法在查询结束时都会丢弃预言机产生的标签。我们提出了SemViews，一种经过认证的语义过滤器，它通过无需预言机调用的信号对元组进行排序（包括先前查询留下的作为语义视图的标签、局部嵌入以及辅助模型的评分），再用无论如何都必须付费获取的标签来细化该排序，并通过新鲜的分层预言机样本来认证其答案。对于每个工作负载和每个目录，其答案满足用户精确率和召回率目标的概率至少为 $1-\delta$，因此过时或误导性的视图可能只会耗费额外的预言机调用，但绝不会损害准确性。
tldr: SemViews通过复用历史查询留下的语义视图标签、局部嵌入和辅助模型评分来减少昂贵的LLM预言机调用，同时以至少1−δ的概率保证任意工作负载下的精确率和召回率目标。
en_tdlr: SemViews is a certified semantic filter that reduces costly LLM oracle calls by reusing labels from prior queries as semantic views, along with local embeddings and helper model scores, while guaranteeing user precision and recall targets with probability at least 1−δ for every workload and catalog.
